invites_target.name: invites_target
invites_target.value: ("invites"."kind" = 'friend' and "invites"."user_id" is not null) or ("invites"."kind" <> 'friend' and "invites"."trip_id" is not null)

trip_members_user_or_guest.name: trip_members_user_or_guest
trip_members_user_or_guest.value: ("trip_members"."user_id" is not null) or ("trip_members"."guest_name" is not null)

trips_dates_order.name: trips_dates_order
trips_dates_order.value: "trips"."end_date" is null or "trips"."start_date" is null or "trips"."end_date" >= "trips"."start_date"
